name: Party Status 2
definition: Business status of the party for processing in the system.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Status of the party maintenance instruction.

StatusReason.name: Status Reason
StatusReason.definition: Specifies the underlying reason for the status of an object.

SystemPartyIdentification.name: System Party Identification
SystemPartyIdentification.definition: Specifications of a party defined within a system.

StatusReasonRule.definition: If Status equals 'Rejected' then StatusReason must be present.

PartyPresenceRule.definition: If Status equals 'Completed' then RelatedPartyIdentification must be present and ResponsiblePartyIdentification must be present.
